text: 1. A scanned copy of the valid and clear information page of the passportThe passport is valid until October 30, 2025 and beyond. Applicants currently residing in the Chinese mainland must also provide a scanned copy of the current valid visa page or residence permit page.2 Scanned copy of high school graduation certificateIf the applicant is a current student, they must submit a certificate of enrollment issued by their school, which includes the expected graduation date, and submit the graduation certificate before registration.3 Scanned copies of the transcripts for each semester/academic year during high schoolIf the applicant has not completed the previous stage of study, they must provide transcripts for all semesters up to the time of application.4 Personal statement (template), resume5 Scanned copy of the Chinese/English language proficiency certificateApplicants who meet the following conditions are not required to provide proof of language proficiencyApplicants whose native language is Chinese are applying for programs taught in Chinese.Applicants whose native language is English are applying for English-taught programs.6 Scanned copy of the certificate of no criminal record (valid within 6 months)Currently residing within the territory of Chinese mainland, one must simultaneously submit a criminal record clearance certificate from both the home country and the period of stay in China.If you are temporarily unable to provide a certificate of no criminal record due to various special circumstances, please fill out the "Personal Commitment Letter". After being tentatively admitted, you must submit the certificate of no criminal record as soon as possible. Only after submitting it can you obtain the admission qualification.7 Scanned copies of officially certified awards and research achievements (not mandatory)8 Scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid within 6 months)Those currently residing in the Chinese mainland and holding a valid "Foreigner's Residence Permit" or "Foreigner's Permanent Residence Identity Card" may use either of the above materials to replace the "Foreigner's Physical Examination Form".9 As of November 1, 2025, applicants under the age of 18 must provide a minor guarantee letter (template).10. Bank statements of the account of myself or my parents for the past six months (with a balance of no less than 5,000 US dollars).11. Other supplementary materials required to be submitted by Northwestern Polytechnical University.
